authority_rule: A release or business-operation claim is valid only when the evidence is current, tied to the exact candidate SHA, and proves the named operation rather than a proxy condition.
acceptable_evidence: Exact-head automated workflow result that executes the mapped critical business journey.
Exact-head integration test proving persisted authoritative state and relevant side effects.
Current environment runtime proof tied to BUILD_SHA and reconciled to the candidate SHA.
Current backup/restore or rollback drill tied to the candidate release when the claim concerns recoverability.
insufficient_by_itself: Stale workflow result from another SHA

freshness.security_dependency_claim: current dependency graph at candidate SHA
freshness.migration_claim: current migration graph plus target database proof
